desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Murder Fights! 💥

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates

How to Play:
🔪 Step on a pad to queue — 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or 4v4
🗺️ Vote on the map with your opponents
💥 Knife or gun, first to 5 rounds takes the match
💰 Win to earn coins, then open crates for new weapons
🔥 Chain wins to build a streak everyone can see

⭐ Secret weapons carry a stamped serial number — the lower the number, the earlier you found it

🚨 Use code RELEASE for free coins!

WARNING:
Exploiting or cheating of any kind is a permanent ban
